news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹0.17 (vs ₹0.13 in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹0.17 (up from ₹0.13 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹912.4m (down 10% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹55.7m (up 33% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 6.1% (up from 4.1% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by lower expenses. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 62% per year but the company’s share price has fallen by 17% per year, which means it is significantly lagging earnings.
